layout_and_spacing.bento_grid_mode: MODE A: THE TETRIS GRID (Asymmetrical layout for focus areas and partner pathways)

key_components.name: NavigationHeader
key_components.description: Sticky glassmorphism header with AVANI Foundation gold-leaf emblem logo, anchor navigation links (About, Approach, Focus Areas, Programmes, Founder, Contact), and action buttons.

key_components.name: KineticHero
key_components.description: High-impact hero with masked reveal headline 'Every Woman Deserves the Opportunity to Shape Her Future.', dual action CTAs, stat badges, and background imagery overlay.

key_components.name: EditorialMarquee
key_components.description: Slow, elegant scrolling editorial ribbon featuring core ethos statements like 'VISION • AMBITION • INDEPENDENCE • DIGITAL INCLUSION • CONFIDENCE'.

key_components.name: ThreeStageApproach
key_components.description: Interactive visual showcase of Confidence → Capability → Career framework with tab switching, metrics, and transformation journey details.

key_components.name: AboutSection
key_components.description: Who We Are, Vision & Mission, emphasizing economic independence, digital inclusion, and women turning potential into opportunity.

key_components.name: FocusAreasGrid
key_components.description: 7 interactive focus area cards with custom icons, hover elevation, and expandable detail drawer/modals.

key_components.name: TargetAudienceSection
key_components.description: Visual pill list & card grid highlighting who AVANI aims to support: rural women, young girls, creators/freelancers, entrepreneurs, mentees, underserved communities.

key_components.name: ProgrammesRoadmap
key_components.description: Detailed breakdown of AVANI's pilot-first programmes (Digital & AI Skills, Content Creation, Career Discovery, Entrepreneurship, Government Scheme Guidance, Leadership).

key_components.name: MeetFounderSection
key_components.description: In-depth editorial profile of Mani Pandey (Founder), highlighting Oxford Global Politics, Symbiosis MBA, UN Women India, G20 EMPOWER, with dual portrait showcase.

key_components.name: PartnerAndInvolvedSection
key_components.description: Dual tabs or side-by-side section for CSR Teams, Govt, Universities, NGOs, Mentors, and Volunteers with clear action paths.

key_components.name: ContactSection
key_components.description: Working interactive contact form integrated with FastAPI backend, displaying email (hello@avanifoundation.org), location (Uttar Pradesh, India), and social placeholders.

key_components.name: Footer
key_components.description: Luxury deep forest green footer with brand logo, quick anchor links, legal note, and tagline 'Empowering women to shape their own futures'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Inter' in index.html or index.css.
Ensure headings use Cormorant Garamond in UPPERCASE with letter-spacing tracking-tight to deliver an Awwwards-grade editorial aesthetic.
Ensure all interactive elements (buttons, nav links, form fields, tab buttons) contain explicit data-testid attributes.
Implement smooth scrolling using Lenis or Framer Motion scroll anchors.
Ensure the contact form submits POST requests to backend endpoint /api/contact and shows success/error toast notifications using Sonner.
Maintain high contrast ratios: text on dark green surfaces must be crisp warm ivory (#FDFBF7) or metallic gold (#D4AF37), and text on light surfaces must be deep slate (#1C2826).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or plain Bootstrap-style grids; use rich asymmetrical editorial layouts with generous padding (py-20 to py-32).
Avoid generic emojis as icons; use Lucide-react or Phosphor icons exclusively.
Ensure all images carry subtle subtle dark green / gold borders or organic radius clips to feel intentional and editorial.
Include data-testid on every interactive component for automated E2E test suite validation.
